_comment: Which wireframe covers which visualiser THIS instance (smart-trust) declares, by route key `<instance>/<visualiser>`: the shape of smart-base's findings/wireframes/index.json. `check:wireframes` reads the `wireframes/` of every `docs` directory a layer declares (cat-harness-tools#281); `docs/` is built at publish and commits nothing, so the wireframes sit in `findings/`, declared as a second `docs` directory in smart-trust.json. `wireframe.css` is the shared mid-fidelity stylesheet, copied from smart-base's findings/wireframes/ so the drawing renders here on its own.
